items.name: time
items.title: Time
items.description: Renders an instant as readable text in the LocaleProvider language (12 分钟前, 今天 14:05; 12 minutes ago, Today 14:05) inside a <time> element, with a tooltip giving the exact local time to the millisecond, the UTC time and the relative time; screen readers get the exact local time too. Within the hour the relative form (12 分钟前, 12 minutes ago) keeps itself current on one shared timer. Props: value (Date | ISO string | epoch ms), clock (bare HH:mm:ss), seconds, placeholder, delay.

items.name: tone-badge
items.title: ToneBadge
items.description: Status badge with a tone: success, error, info, warning, neutral or outline. Tinted backgrounds keep the text at 4.5:1 or better in both themes; the word always states the status, so it never relies on color alone. Map domain states (failed, running, …) to tones at the call site.

items.name: notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: Page-level notice built on Alert: tone error (announced as an alert), warning or neutral, with an optional title, description and one trailing action such as a retry button.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Frameless empty, no-access or error panel built on Empty: icon, title, description and a contents slot for the way out. size="sm" fits an empty table body or list.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Icon-only copy button: copies text, cross-fades the copy icon to a check for 1.5 s and switches its accessible name to 已复制 (Copied). Props: text, label (default 复制, Copy), copiedLabel, variant, size.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: ThemeProvider
items.description: ThemeProvider and useTheme(): system, light or dark, remembered in localStorage (storageKey), applied as the dark class and data-theme on <html> with transitions suppressed during the switch. scoped removes both on unmount, for an app mounted inside a site with its own palette.

items.name: locale-provider
items.title: LocaleProvider
items.description: Sets the language of every Eridanus component inside it, Chinese (zh-CN, the default without a provider) or English (en-US): built-in labels, readable times, time ranges and the calendar. Text passed through a component's props always wins. LocaleProvider takes the locale as a prop, so the app owns the choice; useLocale() reads it and useMessages() picks from a per-locale table.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A labelled meter for a value against its ceiling, such as in-flight work against a cap: label and figures on one line, a thin track under them, role=meter with valueText as the spoken value.

items.name: person-avatar
items.title: PersonAvatar
items.description: A person's picture, or up to two initials while it is missing or loading; tint="name" sets them in white on a color the name picks. Hidden from screen readers; render the name beside it.

items.name: form-input
items.title: FormInput
items.description: A labelled text input with a hint and an error, both linked through aria-describedby, aria-invalid while there is an error, and a required marker. Accepts every input prop.

items.name: search-field
items.title: SearchField
items.description: A 28px toolbar search input with a magnifier and a clear button; Escape clears a non-empty field. label is the accessible name.

items.name: filter-select
items.title: FilterSelect
items.description: A 28px select for filtering a list; the trigger reads "<label> <choice>" and the first option, allLabel (全部, All), means no filter (value "").

items.name: pager
items.title: Pager
items.description: Paging controls under a table: the range shown (第 1–50 条，共 173 条 or 1–50 of 173), an optional page-size select, first/previous/next/last buttons and a page field. Zero-based; folds back to the last page when the total shrinks. Text follows LocaleProvider; the labels prop replaces any part of it. hideSinglePage leaves it out while everything fits on one page; bar pins it to the bottom of the page, and fade lets the rows under it fade out instead of meeting a rule.

items.name: table-kit
items.title: Table kit
items.description: Helpers for open tables built on the shadcn table: TableScroll (scrolls both ways, pins the header, keeps shadcn's rule under each row unless rules={false}; page hands the vertical scroll to the page), TableHeaderRow (shadcn's header row, pinned; or filled, a quiet rounded band that pins 8px under the top), TableRows (loading, empty and rows states), ClickableRow (whole-row click forwarded to the row's first link or button, selected and warning/error tints) clickFirstControl and LockedRow (a faded row the person can see but not open).

items.name: page-layout
items.title: Page layout
items.description: Frameless page structure: Page (document, list or fill-height, optional narrow width of 768px), PageHeader (h1 with badges, actions and a meta line, or a screen-reader-only title), Section (heading over open content), FactLine (dot-separated facts), Facts (label over value) and StatStrip (headline figures, open or on muted cards spread evenly, colored only when they need action) and Toolbar (the controls over a list, wrapping, the search on a line of its own on phones).

items.name: entity-card
items.title: EntityCard
items.description: A list of things a person owns or runs as one-row cards, for when a table would be too wide or too sparse: EntityCard (an 80px row of icon, name with a status badge, a line of facts, an aside such as the owner and age, and a menu; an optional 40px footer; a link element that covers the card and opens the entry, named by the title, with links and buttons inside still clickable; the aside folds away under 640px), EntityCardList (12px apart) and EntityCardSkeleton (placeholders while it loads). Corners match the toolbar's fields.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: An alert dialog for irreversible or outward-facing writes: title, description and a confirm button that repeats the verb. It stays open and cannot be dismissed while onConfirm runs, shows a rejection's message inside, and closes only on success.

items.name: toaster
items.title: AppToaster
items.description: AppToaster (a toast region with the region and close buttons named in the LocaleProvider language) and notify(title, { description, type }) for success toasts that close after 4 s and error toasts that are announced at once and stay.

items.name: id-text
items.title: IdText
items.description: A long identifier shortened in the middle (run_8f3a2c…c91e), monospace, with the full value in a tooltip and for screen readers, and an optional copy button. Props: value, head, tail, copy, copyLabel.

items.name: multi-filter
items.title: MultiFilter
items.description: Toolbar filter that takes several values (状态 failed, running; Status failed, running): a 28px trigger naming what it filters with up to two chosen labels or a count, and a menu of checkbox items, with optional per-value counts, that stays open while values are toggled and ends with a clear item. Value is a string array; [] means no filter. Pairs with useUrlListState.

items.name: time-range-picker
items.title: TimeRangePicker
items.description: Time filter for log, run and metrics pages: trailing presets (最近 15 分钟 … 最近 30 天, or Last 15 minutes … Last 30 days in English) that apply on one click, and a calendar in the LocaleProvider language for a span of whole days, applied with a button; future days are disabled. Value is a time-range TimeRange; store it in the URL with formatTimeRange/parseTimeRange.

items.name: table-sort
items.title: TableSort
items.description: Sortable column headers for table-kit tables: SortableHead (a button in the header cell, with aria-sort) cycles a column through its first direction, the reverse and the table's own order. SortState with formatSort/parseSort (sort=-createdAt) for URLs and queries. Sorting the rows stays with their owner, usually the server.

items.name: table-selection
items.title: TableSelection
items.description: Row selection and bulk actions for table-kit tables: useRowSelection(visibleIds, filters) keeps selected ids across pages and clears them when a filter changes; SelectAllHead (with a mixed state), SelectCell and SelectionBar (count, bulk actions, clear; shown in place of the toolbar while rows are selected) render it.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: The frame of a console app: a sidebar on the window's own background with the product (or, given tenants, a tenant switcher: a bordered pill with the tenant's small tile and name, like the search entry, opening a list, optionally cut to the first few with the current one kept, with a new-tenant item; tiles are rounded squares or circles; or brand.lockup, a whole lockup such as one SVG of mark and wordmark, which collapsing clips to its mark while the mark and the nav icons keep one column), an optional search entry, under the header or (placement topbar) centred in the top bar, that opens the app's search on click or ⌘K, navigation groups (pinned or recent items are groups too) under small headings (icon, label, badge, current page) and, at its foot, the account (avatar and name, opening a menu with its items, optional switch rows such as an admin mode, the system/light/dark theme choice and sign-out) beside a few icon buttons such as notifications; the page sits in a card inset from the window. A breadcrumb or page-wide actions add a top bar inside the card with the sidebar toggle. On desktop the sidebar's edge drags between 180 and 320px, and letting go short of that, ⌘B or a click on the edge collapses it to icons with tooltips; it remembers both; opens as a sheet under 768px. The card scrolls by itself, so Page fill gets an exact height. Needs a ThemeProvider above it; renderLink plugs in the router's links. AppHeaderShell is the frame for pages without a sidebar, such as a workspace picker before any tenant is chosen: a top bar with the square logo, text links (external ones open a new tab), actions and the account menu, over a scrolling main area, narrow or wide.
items.docs: AppShell reads the theme from ThemeProvider: wrap the app in <ThemeProvider>. shadcn's sidebar depends on input; if the CLI asks to overwrite components/ui/input.tsx, answer no to keep the Eridanus fork.
